summary: The candidate meets the contract and all 11 host-reported tests passed. calculator.mjs uses the specified rates, which are frozen and stored without inherited properties, so names like __proto__ are rejected. It validates safe nonnegative whole-number counts, the reads-plus-writes limit and the 272K input cap, uses the exact cost formulas without rounding, and breakEvenReuse returns 1 for both models. index.html loads ./calculator.mjs and has the required controls, defaults and button-type presets that keep the current model. It recalculates on every input and change, shows the total with $ and 6 decimals, and clears the total, breakdown and bar when input is invalid. The error area is announced to screen readers. The page shows a segmented cost bar, cache share and break-even statement, all copy is Korean, and the source, date, scope and exclusions are disclosed. HTML is built only from fixed internal strings and numbers, and the layout uses minmax(0,1fr) columns with an internally scrolling rates table. Minor only: the total reads $0.000000 until the module loads, which matters only if the page isn't served over HTTP.
